function: DNA-binding global transcriptional regulator which is involved in the adaptive response to starvation and acts by directly or indirectly controlling the expression of numerous genes in response to nutrient availability. During rapid exponential growth, CodY is highly active and represses genes whose products allow adaptation to nutrient depletion.
